'''Horton Salm'''<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> He was the older brother of [[Keyser Salm]], a pilot of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]].<ref name="Rendezvous Point" /> He flew a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Endor]] as [[Gray Leader]] in [[Gray Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gray Squadron]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> During the battle, Salm and his squadron wrecked the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Vehement]]''<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

[[File:HortonSalmFlightHelmet-SWCOT.png|thumb|right|250px|Salm's helmet at Endor]]
